messages:
Gabe (Docs): heads-up: i'm assembling a compact docs PR to clarify rate/quotas for the tiered credits rollout. plan: one short FAQ, three tiny SDK snippets (node/python/curl), a minimal express middleware, and a single Grafana/PromQL example for the Usage panel. will open in ~2h.

Nora (DevEx): great. please make snippets paste-ready for quickstart and show how to read realtime headers vs dashboard numbers. devs get confused about per-request headers vs aggregated metrics.

Gabe (Docs): noted. will add a one-liner: "Headers = real-time per-request snapshot. Console = aggregated view (per-route & per-tier)." and link the console panel.

Hiro (Eng): prod header names are X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining and X-Redwood-Quota-Window. we still emit X-Quota-* for older clients. include fallback logic in the examples.

Gabe (Docs): can you paste a tiny express middleware i can drop in? want it <=3 lines.

Hiro (Eng): sure: ```js
app.use((req,res,next)=>{const r=res.getHeader('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining')||res.getHeader('X-Quota-Remaining');req.quotaRemaining=Number(r||0);next()})
```

Ruth (PM): also add a short FAQ Q: "What happens if I downgrade mid-cycle?" Answer: credits are prorated and customers typically get a short grace period — link billing playbook for exact terms.

Imani (Billing): yes — phrase as "typically a short (~7 day) grace period; enterprise agreements may differ" and link the playbook. add a one-line reconciliation tip: use billing exports + redwood_tokens_consumed_total for spot checks.

Gabe (Docs): added the cautious wording and reconciliation pointer. thanks.

Nora (DevEx): snippets we need: 1) Node fetch wrapper showing header parse + fallback, 2) Python requests example for embedding calls that prints remaining, 3) curl one-liner. keep each under 6 lines.

Gabe (Docs): node draft: ```js
// quick node fetch quota check
const r = await fetch(url,{headers});
const rem = r.headers.get('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining')||r.headers.get('X-Quota-Remaining')||'0';
console.log('remaining tokens:', Number(rem));
```

Gabe (Docs): python draft: ```py
# python requests quick check
r = requests.post(url,json=payload,headers=headers)
print(int(r.headers.get('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining') or 0))
```

Gabe (Docs): curl: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" $URL | grep -i X-Redwood-Quota
```

Hiro (Eng): add note: burst credits are surfaced as metric redwood_burst_credit_balance and as a separate header X-Redwood-Burst-Balance on some endpoints. include both in the reconciliation note.

Imani (Billing): careful — not all customers have burst top-ups. phrase as: "Burst/top-up balances appear as redwood_burst_credit_balance and may be present as X-Redwood-Burst-Balance on responses for eligible accounts."

Gabe (Docs): updated language to be conservative.

Ruth (PM): for the Grafana panel, product wants a simple PromQL showing token consumption by customer_tier over 7d (exclude internal/test). engineering suggested: ```promql
sum by(customer_tier) (increase(redwood_tokens_consumed_total{env="prod", customer_type!~"internal|test"}[7d]))
```
Legend: {{customer_tier}}

Hiro (Eng): looks good. recommend setting legend and time-range to 7d. mention we can filter by region if teams want per-region panels.

Gabe (Docs): added a short note about region filtering and the legend tip.

DocsBot: PR checklist reminder: include changelog entry, migration notes (header rename), and crosslink to billing playbook when pricing/credits are mentioned.

Gabe (Docs): thanks DocsBot. i'll add changelog and migration note to the PR and tag @Nora, @Hiro, @Imani for review. planning to open at 1791242000.

Nora (DevEx): i'll run the snippets in quickstart against staging and report any tweaks.

Hiro (Eng): i'll validate the PromQL against staging metrics and confirm header coverage.

Gabe (Docs): thanks team. quick, clear docs here should cut support tickets. :sparkles:
